items.about: Tests for claims C1-C9 and C13

claims.text: Preserve independent capture groups in MultiReplace
MultiReplace([(r'(a)\1', 'X')], regex=True) raises re.error, although the search pattern is valid.
Keep the combined-expression path for patterns without captures.
When any pattern has captures, match patterns independently against the original text, choosing the leftmost match and breaking ties by input order.
Cache each pattern's next match, restarting a search only when another replacement overlaps it.
Preserve Python's empty-match behavior and never scan replacement text.
This fallback can cost more than a single combined regex, especially with many patterns or overlapping matches; the class documentation now states that tradeoff.

A simple absent-alternative check with 1,000 and 10,000 input characters took approximately 0.00061 and 0.00748 seconds locally (best of three), a narrow check against repeatedly rescanning an unmatched suffix, not a general performance guarantee.
Ten capture-isolation regressions fail before the fix (numeric backreferences, conditionals, duplicate named groups, and internal-name collisions; string and compiled inputs).
Final focused strutils tests and doctests: 97 passed, including empty/nonempty adjacency, input priority, replacement text, and compiled flag controls.
Full tests and module doctests before the final documentation/flag-control-only additions: 808 passed, 1 skipped, 22 subtests passed.
Production logic is unchanged since that full run.
